review.imagery: 46 gallery entries include 6 dated site photographs. All twenty primary assets, the complete 65-page brochure index, 94 native resources and six September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. One repeated sunset balcony, repeated brochure scenes, texture images and generic lifestyle material were excluded. Twenty-one brochure scenes add full architecture, lobby, gym, garden, duplex and bathroom views. Developer-published exterior views can show both adjoining Cotier phases. Historical photographs retain their own project history attribution and surrounding-building context.
review.floorPlans: All thirteen whole physical pages 2–14 were visually reviewed on four contacts. The packet carries the original Cotier House header. Ground/podium 1 retain paired 3 BR townhouses, podium 2 retains 3 BR homes and upper levels retain paired 3/4 BR duplex portions. Complete margins, legends and source-page links remain intact. No whole-home area was inferred from a level. The broker’s sole home preview is behind its contact form and was unretrieved. Thirteen complete building sheets retain townhouse, apartment and paired 3/4 BR duplex portions. No individual saleable home areas are printed. A separate broker home preview is form-gated and unretrieved. Confirm complete contractual layouts, combined areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole brochure map 12 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All six estimates follow the printed schedule. Gold Souq Metro remains regional access. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures, factsheets and plan packets retain their actual broker/design-host attribution. Full sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual home areas and standalone layouts, combined multi-level home areas, the form-gated broker drawing, exact visitor entrance, current certified site progress and final phase-specific design/outlook remain unavailable or unverified.
